about: Maureen A. McCready, Attorney at Law is listed on North Pearl Street downtown and works out of Elma, and her site names her across Amherst, Depew and Elma. She is the named attorney and publishes her own email address.

7 reviews at 3.3, below the ten the minimum footprint gate asks for, so this firm is listed rather than certified. She describes three routes through a case, from mediation to litigation, and explains four stages. Her site scores 56 out of 100 with 459 milliseconds of blocking time, and she publishes no fee.
